svg.title: Beryl scoped thread and root list mockup
svg.desc: An exploratory refinement showing exhaustive recent-first thread lists scoped by root and exhaustive recent-first root lists scoped by runtime.
svg.text: Threads remain threads; roots remain roots. Scope changes, while every list stays exhaustive and recent-first.
Merged toolbar with a conditional branch-lineage strip
This strip is absent for top-level threads.
THREAD SWITCHER · ONE EXHAUSTIVE THREAD LIST MOVING THROUGH THREE STATES
Every thread, sorted by most recent activity.

svg.text: The list is exhaustive, virtualized, and recent-first. Its header states the active root scope.
Choose the root whose threads should be shown.
Choosing beryl returns immediately to the exhaustive thread list, now scoped to beryl.
Every thread under C:\Users\user\p\beryl, still sorted by most recent activity.
